does: Applies the resolved roll adjustments to the conditional functors of a spell cast: for each FunctorConditional whose roll Guid has RollAdjustments it calls esv::interrupt::AdjustConditionRoll and flips the functor's condition result when the success changed.

evidence.says: pairs with the Toolkit's esv::interrupt::AdjustFunctorConditionRolls (0.45); 0x158-byte elements, Guid at +0x140, result byte at +0x1C
called once right after each interrupt adjustment of an attack or a save in a cast (SetRoll, SetReroll, AdjustRoll)
